lead_profile_text: Looking to move abroad and short let my home
stl_goal: Short-let the family home to cover the mortgage and fund a glamping-site startup in Somerset during the early years
property_situation: Currently owner-occupied; planning to relocate to Somerset around August/September 2027 to start a glamping business; on a standard residential mortgage, in talks with broker about a buy-to-let switch, possibly via a 1-year residential bridge first
property_type: 3-bed home with two off-street parking spaces, large garden, newly built summer house with cinema projector, downstairs toilet plus upstairs bathroom
profile_confidence: medium — thorough structured questions (insurance, occupancy, storage, flooring, fees) but no hard skepticism or resistance, so archetype fit is reasonable but not as sharply evidenced as a harder-edged analytical lead
primary_blocker: Long runway to an Aug/Sep 2027 move date and an unresolved mortgage-type switch (residential to buy-to-let)
language_signals: we've got a buffer for that
the house is set up in any which way we can use it
having the actual figures there... makes a huge, huge difference to the business plan moving forward

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: the time frame that we were looking is around August, September next year
delay_signals.context: Andy and his partner are relocating to Somerset to start a glamping business; move date depends partly on planning permission and site appraisal for that business
delay_signals.timeline_given: ~12-13 months out (Aug/Sep 2027), with the goalpost possibly moving depending on planning permission

meeting_flow.opening_phrase: So how you doing? ... I thought I'd start just understanding a bit more on sort of your current situation
rapport_topics: building the summer house/cinema room himself
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: Direct pivot from 'what's the current situation with the property' straight into the buy-to-let mortgage note and figures
meeting_flow.income_intro: So wishes what we've managed to get from your information... we're looking about 39,000 of gross, which translates to about 20,000 in net or about sort of 1700 per month
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: I mean I suppose what would be useful to go through is obviously while you're away... what level of oversight do you have to see how things are running
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: Extended discussion of amenities (summer house, shed storage, carpet vs wood floor) building confidence before close
meeting_flow.close_phrase: A couple things I do after this call for you is I'll send you an email and it just sort of summarize everything we've spoken about
